cases.question: 分析一下最近30天的销量，你能得出什么结论？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 周期, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期' AS 周期, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
最近30天销量整体环比上升，增长面较广。
- 本期销量42162件、订单16075单、GMV 9665990.5元、客单价601.31元，四项均高于上期 [查询1]。
- 类目销量增长最多为鞋靴+380件、宠物+268件、运动户外+243件；男装-89件、护肤-53件下滑 [查询5]。
- 渠道中短视频增速最快+9.4%，站外联盟-3.0%、品牌广告-1.0%为仅有的下滑渠道 [查询2]。
- 建议：优先补强鞋靴、宠物、运动户外的库存与投放，并排查男装、护肤及下滑商品183号、15号的原因。
- 说明：商品维度仅返回销量前10与下滑前10，未覆盖全部商品；下滑原因数据无法判断。

cases.summary:
退货率小幅上升，主因是“不喜欢”类退款增长，商品退货率未算出。

- 本期退款 1457 笔、419,373.63 元，退货率 4.3%；上期 1297 笔、354,683.1 元、3.9% [查询1]
- “不喜欢”退款 72,169.61 元、241 笔，比上期增加 22,639.42 元（+45.7%），是增长最快的原因 [查询2]
- 该原因增长集中在手机配件热销款220号（+3,954.8 元）、运动户外热销款27号（+3,313.32 元）、手机配件热销款204号（+2,699.59 元）[查询7]
- 商品维度退货率因查询次数用完未算出，无法判断哪些商品退货率最高 [查询5/6]
- 建议：先核查220号、27号、204号的详情页描述与实物是否一致，并补跑商品退货率数据。

cases.question: 下个月我应该重点推哪些商品？
cases.sql: SELECT c.name AS 类目, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 本期GMV, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期GMV, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 1) AS GMV环比增长率, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS 本期销量, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS 上期销量, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN o.id END) AS 本期订单数, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN o.id END) AS 上期订单数 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN safe.categories AS c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND ((o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01') OR (o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02')) GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 本期GMV DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
下月优先推宠物、文具、运动户外的高增长低退货款。
- 宠物类目本期GMV 817,186.98，环比+17.6%；宠物热销款209号GMV 142,328.42、+61.8%，退货率仅2.3% [查询2][查询3][查询5]
- 文具类目+17.3%；文具热销款45号GMV 147,736.23、+59.4%，退货率4.1% [查询2][查询3][查询5]
- 运动户外热销款85号GMV 133,949.12、+24.3%，退货率0.5%为前20最低 [查询3][查询5]
- 手机配件204号虽+52.5%，但退货率7.9%、退款10,241.72元，建议谨慎放量 [查询3][查询5]
- 建议：把209号、45号、85号作为主推并优先配广告预算；广告ROI仅覆盖5个计划，主推款无投放数据，需补测后再定预算 [查询4]
- 缺退款与ROI之外的商品级流量、库存数据，无法判断增长原因和备货上限。

cases.question: 今天有什么需要我注意的？
cases.sql: SELECT '今天' AS 周期, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-31' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上一周期' AS 周期, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-30' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-31' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
今天最需注意退款异常：退货率升至4.6%，集中在少数单品。
- 今天GMV 332451.1、订单566单，均高于上期，但客单价从637.45降到587.37 [查询1]。

cases.question: 上个月GMV为什么比上上个月低？

cases.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-01' THEN '上个月' ELSE '上上个月' END AS 期间, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND ((o.paid_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-01') OR (o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01')) GROUP BY 期间 LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
上个月GMV并未下降，反而高于上上个月，问题前提不成立。
- 上个月GMV 9,072,501.5，高于上上个月8,114,142.58；订单数15,345对13,917，客单价591.24对583.04 [查询1]。

- 退款金额从326,007.97升至356,867.86，但退货率从4.0%降至3.9% [查询4]。
- 建议：先核对“GMV下降”的数据口径（如是否按支付时间、是否含退款），再决定是否排查；宠物类目可单独看流量与转化。

cases.question: 最近30天广告投放效果怎么样，钱花得值吗？
cases.sql: SELECT c.campaign_name AS 活动名称, c.daily_budget AS 日预算, SUM(ads.spend) AS 花费, SUM(ads.attributed_gmv) AS 归因成交金额, ROUND(SUM(ads.attributed_gmv) / NULLIF(SUM(ads.spend), 0), 2) AS ROI, SUM(ads.clicks) AS 点击量, SUM(ads.impressions) AS 曝光量, SUM(ads.attributed_orders) AS 归因订单数 FROM safe.ad_daily_stats AS ads JOIN safe.ad_campaigns AS c ON c.id = ads.campaign_id WHERE ads.stat_date >= '2026-10-02' AND ads.stat_date < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.campaign_name, c.daily_budget ORDER BY 花费 DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
最近30天广告ROI 1.75，低于上期2.07，钱花得不如上期值。
- 本期花费216,670.86元、归因成交379,574.74元、ROI 1.75；上期ROI 2.07，规模收缩但回报同步走低 [查询3]。
- 活动56号-品牌广告花费66,811.43元、ROI 1.41，为5个活动中最低；活动31号-付费搜索ROI 1.18最低但花费仅8,502.67元 [查询2]。
- 直播带货本期花费为0，上期花费99,846.44元、ROI 3.12，高ROI渠道停投是回报下滑的可能因素之一，但数据无法确认原因 [查询4]。
- 建议：先压缩品牌广告预算，核查其单次点击花费2.00元偏高的原因，并小规模恢复直播带货测试 [查询5]。
- 缺数据：按天走势只返回前20行，10月22日至31日明细未展示。

cases.question: 哪个渠道最值得加大投入？
cases.sql: SELECT c.name AS 渠道名称, c.type AS 渠道类型, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 本期GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN o.id END) AS 本期订单数, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN o.id END) AS 上期订单数 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.channels AS c ON c.id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND ((o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01') OR (o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02')) GROUP BY c.name, c.type ORDER BY 本期GMV DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
社交种草最值得加大投入，ROI最高且退款率低。
- 社交种草本期ROI 2.76，比上期升15.1个百分点，但花费仅21007.22，上期为147889.01，投入明显收缩 [查询3]。
- 社交种草本期GMV 1580405.94、2580单，退款率3.6%，规模第二且成交质量较好 [查询1][查询4]。
- 自然搜索GMV最高2292288.47，但无广告花费数据，无法评估投放回报 [查询1][查询3]。
- 建议：优先把社交种草预算恢复到上期水平附近，再按ROI表现逐步加投，并同步监测退款率。

cases.question: 本月退款为什么变多了？
cases.sql: SELECT '本月至今' AS 周期, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) FROM safe.refunds AS r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01') AS 退款金额, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safe.refunds AS r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01') AS 退款笔数, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount), 0) FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01') AS GMV, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) FROM safe.refunds AS r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01') / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01'), 0) * 100 AS 退货率百分比 UNION ALL SELECT '上一周期', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) FROM safe.refunds AS r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safe.refunds AS r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01'), (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount), 0) FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-01'), (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) FROM safe.refunds AS r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01') / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-01'), 0) * 100 LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
本月退款金额和笔数均上升，退货率小幅走高，主因集中在少数类目和商品。

- 本月退款 427,809.93 元、1,493 笔，退货率 4.28%；上期 356,867.86 元、1,295 笔、3.93% [查询1]
- 原因上“不喜欢”增量最大：+24,237.96 元、+55 笔；“发错货”+16,469.12 元、“尺码不符”+14,904.43 元 [查询2]
- 类目上母婴增量最大：+47,830.31 元（184→251 笔），其次鞋靴 +26,207.03 元、食品 +23,648.10 元 [查询4]
- 渠道上付费搜索增量最大：+27,222.54 元、+36 笔 [查询3]
- 建议：先核查母婴热销款22号、272号、153号的发货与详情页描述，并复盘付费搜索投放素材 [查询5][查询6]

数据只能说明退款集中在哪些原因、类目和商品，无法判断具体诱因。

cases.question: 最近物流有没有拖后腿？
cases.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN '本期' ELSE '上期' END AS 周期, COUNT(*) AS 包裹量, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT s.delivered_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 已签收包裹量, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN NOT s.delivered_at IS NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.paid_at, s.delivered_at) END), 1) AS 平均发货时效小时, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.delivered_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS 未签收包裹占比 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.shipments AS s ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND ((o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01') OR (o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02')) GROUP BY 周期 ORDER BY 周期 DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
整体物流没有明显拖后腿，但个别承运商和地区有恶化。
- 本期平均支付到签收 200.7 小时，上期 200.8 小时，基本持平；未签收占比 10.5%，上期 10.7% [查询1]。
- 韵达时效增加 1.5 小时、未签收占比升至 11.3%（357 件），是唯一占比上升的承运商；圆通、顺丰也各慢 1.1、0.7 小时 [查询4]。
- 辽宁时效增加 4.1 小时（279.1 小时），湖北增加 2.1 小时，恶化最明显 [查询3]。
- “物流太慢”退款占比 15.4%，低于上期 16.7%，未传导到退款 [查询2]。
- 建议：优先核查韵达和辽宁线路的揽收与中转，对韵达未签收的 357 件逐单跟进。

cases.question: 各类目最近表现怎么样，哪些在下滑？

cases.summary:
整体GMV和订单数均高于上期，但男装、护肤、图书三类目在下滑。

- 整体本期GMV 9,665,990.5、订单16,075，均高于上期；退款金额从354,683.1升至419,373.63 [查询1][查询2]。
- 下滑最多：男装GMV -38,364.22（-11.3%），护肤 -25,161.68（-9.2%），图书 -22,864.79（-3.2%）；男装订单数持平但客单价从194.91降至172.85 [查询5][查询6]。

缺数据：美妆、家居、运动户外、生鲜、饮料本期无广告花费，投放效率无法判断。

cases.question: 老客复购情况怎么样？
cases.sql: WITH first_pay AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at FROM safe.orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND NOT paid_at IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id), base AS (SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.customer_id, o.channel_id, o.paid_at, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount AS gmv, CASE WHEN o.paid_at > f.first_paid_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_repurchase FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN first_pay AS f ON f.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND NOT o.paid_at IS NULL), agg AS (SELECT '本期' AS 周期, c.name AS 渠道, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.is_repurchase = 1 THEN b.customer_id END) AS 复购客户数, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.is_repurchase = 1 THEN b.order_id END) AS 复购订单数, SUM(CASE WHEN b.is_repurchase = 1 THEN b.gmv ELSE 0 END) AS 复购GMV, SUM(b.gmv) AS 总GMV FROM base AS b JOIN safe.channels AS c ON c.id = b.channel_id WHERE b.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND b.paid_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY c.name UNION ALL SELECT '上期' AS 周期, c.name AS 渠道, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.is_repurchase = 1 THEN b.customer_id END), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.is_repurchase = 1 THEN b.order_id END), SUM(CASE WHEN b.is_repurchase = 1 THEN b.gmv ELSE 0 END), SUM(b.gmv) FROM base AS b JOIN safe.channels AS c ON c.id = b.channel_id WHERE b.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND b.paid_at < '2026-10-02' GROUP BY c.name) SELECT 周期, 渠道, 复购客户数, 复购订单数, ROUND(复购GMV, 2) AS 复购GMV, ROUND(复购GMV / NULLIF(总GMV, 0) * 100, 1) AS 复购GMV占比 FROM agg ORDER BY 渠道, 周期 DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
老客复购整体稳中有升，复购GMV占比达96.7%。
- 本期复购客户13,247人、复购订单15,552单，均高于上期12,586人、14,680单；复购GMV 935.06万元，占比96.7%（上期95.9%）[查询2]。
- 自然搜索复购规模最大（3,605人、2,229,454.54元），社交种草次之；仅站外联盟复购GMV略降[查询1]。
- 类目上宠物复购GMV 136,498.56元、占比升至10.4%，鞋靴、童装上升；手机配件占比由10.0%降至7.3%，美妆、家纺也回落[查询4]。
- 建议：优先补货并加大推广宠物热销款209号、鞋靴105号、童装49号，同时排查手机配件294号、美妆296号复购下滑原因。
- 说明：第4步客单价与退款数据仅覆盖“老客复购”渠道，非全店口径，解读需谨慎[查询3]。

cases.question: 上个月客单价为什么下降了？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 期间, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期' AS 期间, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
整体客单价并未下降，9月为591.24元，高于8月的583.04元。
- 整体客单价上升，GMV从811.41万元增至907.25万元，订单数从13917单增至15345单 [查询1]。
- 分渠道看，直播带货客单价从597.11元降至571.96元，降幅4.2%，是唯一明显下降的渠道 [查询4]。
- 分类目看，美妆、家居、宠物、文具、女装客单价均下降，其中美妆降22.67元、家居降22.61元 [查询5]。
- 直播带货下，文具客单价降15.1%、宠物降12.6%、美妆降10.0% [查询6]。
- 建议：先确认“客单价下降”指的是哪个渠道或类目，再重点排查直播带货中文具、宠物、美妆的选品和组合装设置。

cases.question: 最近30天哪些地区卖得好，哪些地区需要加强？
cases.sql: SELECT o.province AS 收货省份, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS 签收包裹数, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.paid_at, s.delivered_at)), 1) AS 平均发货时效小时 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.shipments AS s ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE NOT s.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY o.province ORDER BY 平均发货时效小时 DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
广东体量最大但微降，浙江、北京增长最强，江西、安徽需加强。
- 本期GMV前三：广东131.98万（环比-0.7%）、浙江109.13万（+17.9%）、江苏98.32万（+5.9%）[查询3]
- 增长最快：北京+20.7%、浙江+17.9%、河南+16.6%[查询3]
- 需加强：江西-9.2%、安徽-4.8%、山东-4.1%；山东退款3.61万偏高[查询3][查询2]
- 物流偏慢：辽宁279.1小时、河南274.5小时、河北274.4小时，明显高于其他省份约180小时[查询1]
- 建议：优先排查江西、安徽下滑原因，并对辽宁、河南、河北的物流时效做专项跟进。

cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 周期, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN safe.categories AS c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = '童装' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期' AS 周期, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN safe.categories AS c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = '童装' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
童装类目最近30天整体向好，GMV和订单数都高于上期。

- 本期GMV 471,987.38元、订单1,566笔，上期438,254.75元、1,457笔，两项均增长 [查询1]。
- 208号贡献最大（139,709.12元），295号增长最明显（+8,123.17元，销量109→155），202号下滑最多（-3,556.36元）[查询5]。
- 老客复购GMV从50,937.07元升至72,172.34元，是渠道中增量最突出的 [查询2]。
- 本期退款合计14,668.17元，退货率约3.1%，其中尺码不符3,951.26元（17笔）居首 [查询3][查询4]。
- 建议：优先核查295号备货，并在商品页补充尺码对照表，压降尺码不符退款。
